own_solution.law: Ideal transformer V_s = V_p/n; full-wave bridge with two constant-drop diodes conducting: v_L = Vm|sin wt| - 2Vd when positive, else 0; average V = (1/pi)[2 Vm cos(alpha) - 2Vd (pi - 2 alpha)], sin(alpha) = 2Vd/Vm
assumptions: constant-drop diode model with 0.7 V each, two in series (stated)
average taken over a full cycle in steady state

notes: Base: V_s = 57.5 V rms, Vm = 81.3173 V, 2Vd = 1.4 V, sin(alpha) = 0.0172165, alpha = 0.0172174 rad; V_avg = (162.61046 - 4.35002)/pi = 50.3759 V. With mains 244 V rms: V_s = 61 V, Vm = 86.2670 V, alpha = 0.0162294 rad; V_avg = (172.51134 - 4.35279)/pi = 53.5265 V. Load resistance cancels because the diode model is a constant voltage drop with ideal source/transformer (load current I = v_L/R, v_L independent of R). TAC9C and T644B use 'a small amount' instead of 14 V; noted as apparent numeral-free renderings.
